title: SWF: SoundStreamHead and SoundStreamBlock tags
description: Unit tests for sound stream tag encoding in packages/swf. Check packages/swf/src/compile.ts for SoundStreamHead (tag 18) and SoundStreamBlock (tag 19) handling. Create a FlashDocument with a SoundItem in stream sync mode attached to a frame, export to SWF, verify SoundStreamHead tag exists (type 18). Tests in packages/swf/src/__tests__/soundstream.test.ts.
